title: Muse: Starlit Void
tagline: Hexsweeper 3D's Goldberg hex-sphere, adrift in a soft void as a constellation to be charted.
aesthetic: A 3am observatory above the atmosphere — deep indigo void, brushed-slate sphere, frosted-glass tiles. Cleared wells pool into twilight indigo, numbers orbit as thin rings of starlight. Flags burn as small coral lighthouses, warm against the cold cosmos.
mechanicTwist: Numbered wells wash with a faint count-tint (1 ice-blue → 6 rose-amber) and render counts as luminous concentric rings; hovering a number briefly draws hairline constellation threads to adjacent same-count tiles.
helpLede: Six neighbors, one sphere, first dig always safe. Flag the stars, trust the rings, and let the void reveal itself.
hudNote: The void holds its breath — chart lightly.
